values.quote: empowering her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 6 seconds

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack has an uncancellable windup and gains bonus range.
mechanics.quote: to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}

mechanics.claim: The enhanced attack resets Leona's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Shield of Daybreak {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Leona's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The enhanced attack applies other on-hit effects and can critically strike, but crits do not interact with the bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: The enhanced attack will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack does not put Leona's basic attack on cooldown, effectively granting a second attack reset.
mechanics.quote: Shield of Daybreak's attack does not put '''Leona's''' basic attack on cooldown.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack can miss if the target is blinded, nullifying the effect entirely.
mechanics.quote: Shield of Daybreak's attack can {{tip|blind|miss}}, nullifying its effects entirely.
